rules.title: Rental assistance (source-of-income) protected from housing discrimination
rules.requirement: Boston landlords cannot refuse to rent to you because you use rental assistance such as a Section 8, disability, or veterans voucher. You can file a complaint with the Boston Fair Housing Commission.
rules.requirement_es: En Boston, los propietarios no pueden negarse a alquilarle porque usted usa asistencia para el alquiler, como un voucher de la Sección 8, de discapacidad o de veteranos. Puede presentar una queja ante la Comisión de Vivienda Justa de Boston.
rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing in the City of Boston; no building-type limits stated on the page.
rules.key_value: Rental assistance is a protected class
rules.caveat: Informational web page; the specific ordinance or regulation section is not cited, so the citation is approximate. The page says it enforces local, state and federal law.
